page_title: PSG 2-1 ETI | PSG v St Etienne 12/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
90+3' The ball is cleared after Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Zuriko Davitashvili departs the field of play to be replaced by Djyilian N'Guessan (St Etienne).
86' PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
83' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 21:7.
80' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) replacing Bradley Barcola.
75' Mathieu Vernice shows a yellow card to Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) for his blatant foul.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Senny Mayulu trots off the pitch and is replaced by Vitinha (PSG).
70' Nuno Mendes (PSG) runs onto a ball from Fabian Ruiz and tries an ambitious shot from mid-range. The keeper has it covered but it goes just over the bar anyway.
64' 2 - 1 Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes the free kick with a powerful low drive that goes inside the left-hand post and ends up behind the goalkeeper. A real jaw dropper!
64' The free kick will be taken by Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne).
63' Here is a change. Louis Mouton is going off and Eirik Horneland gives the last tactical orders to Mathis Amougou (St Etienne).
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Willian Pacho coming on for Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lucas Hernandez (PSG) walks off the pitch to be replaced by Desire Doue.
62' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
60' The linesman makes the right call and PSG will have a corner.
58' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) receives a yellow card for infringement.
58' What a huge chance for Ousmane Dembele (PSG). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
56' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) sends an accurate pass to Ousmane Dembele, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
52' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 4:3.
51' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mathieu Vernice no option but to blow his whistle.
49' Kang-In Lee (PSG) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
49' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
49' PSG are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
48' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Mathieu Cafaro comes off for Augustine Boakye (St Etienne).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
45+1' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The game is interrupted. Kang-In Lee (PSG) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
41' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The PSG players look gutted.
40' The PSG players halt their celebrations as referee Mathieu Vernice makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

39' Bradley Barcola (PSG) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Gautier Larsonneur is just a bystander as the ball flies into the middle of the goal. The score is 3:0.
36' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
36' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to PSG.

35' Great save! Bradley Barcola (PSG) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Gautier Larsonneur. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to PSG.
32' That's unlucky! Kang-In Lee (PSG) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
31' Senny Mayulu (PSG) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
29' Nuno Mendes (PSG) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
28' Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
27' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gianluigi Donnarumma intercepts the ball.
23' 2 - 0 Goal! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Gautier Larsonneur into the bottom left corner.
22' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
21' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to PSG!
21' Referee Mathieu Vernice makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
21' The players claim that Leo Petrot (St Etienne) handled the ball and it seems they are right. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for PSG!
20' Nuno Mendes (PSG) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
18' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.
17' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

16' Kang-In Lee (PSG) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the top left corner. Gautier Larsonneur has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. Now PSG have a corner.
13' 1 - 0 Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
12' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) works the corner short.
9' Bradley Barcola (PSG) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
7' St Etienne failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
7' St Etienne control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' St Etienne enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' St Etienne force a corner. They send men into the box.

1' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off an easy save. The referee points to the corner flag and St Etienne will take a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
PSG will kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
